definitions.short: Elasah , the name of four Israelites
definitions.full: H501. Elasah אֶלְעָשָׂה proper name, masculine ( God has made , compare יַעֲשִׂיאֵל עֲשָׂהאֵל, etc.) a. descendant of Judah 1Chr 2:39-40 ,. b. a Benjamite 1Chr 8:37 ; 9:43 . c. of the line of Pashur Ezra 10:22 . d. son of Shaphan Jer 29:3 . אֶלְמֶּלֶט see אֱלִיפֶלָט .
